messages:
Jordan Kim: FYI — Acme (enterprise) wants a 2-week POC for their QA assistant. Use case: ingest product docs + retrieval + generative answers. They expect ~80k sessions/day, avg ~1.2k tokens/session, peak concurrency ~200 requests/min during business hours. They asked for Dedicated capacity for data isolation and asked that latency be <400ms p95. Budget they've signaled: ~$5k for the POC. Need sizing, rough cost, and success criteria by EOD so we can confirm timeline.

Sam Patel: thanks. Clarifying q's: is 80k sessions/day simultaneous or total across 24h? and do they expect streaming or single-response completions?

Jordan Kim: total across 24h, bursty during 9–17 PT. Single-response completions (no streaming).

Nina Gomez: quick back-of-envelope: 80k * 1.2k tokens = ~96M tokens/day. That's ~1,111 tokens/sec sustained. Peak could be ~3x during daytime ~3.3k tokens/sec. With single-response latency target <400ms, we should aim for smaller model variants or larger batch-friendly GPUs.

Nina Gomez: two high-level options:
- cost-optimized: dedicated A10G-class GPUs (quantized 8-bit) + aggressive prefix/KV caching — likely 2–4 GPUs for the daytime bursts; estimate cost ~ $3k–4.5k for 14 days (ballpark).
- performance-first: H100s (fp16) to guarantee latency headroom — 1–2 H100s, cost ~ $18k–24k for 14 days.

Sam Patel: prefer hybrid: run on Hosted (autoscale) with model quantization + caching for most traffic, and provision 1 dedicated GPU for the canary/isolated traffic they require. Hosted handles bursts, dedicated handles isolation SLA. That should keep cost closer to their budget.

Oliver Chen: from finance — the customer's $5k POC cap is tight. If they require dedicated hardware 24/7 for 2 weeks, we can't meet that with H100s. With a Hosted-led hybrid approach and a single reserved A10G for isolated hits, I can make a ~$4.2k estimate (includes usage + one A10G reserved, bandwidth, and SRE support). Need formal approval but feasible.

Maya Rao: noted security asks from Acme: SSO (SAML/SCIM), data retention policy, encryption at rest, and SOC2 audit copy. They also sent a short security questionnaire (attached in their email). Priya, can you confirm whether Private/VPC is required for the POC or if Hosted with data retention controls is OK?

Priya Singh: Acme said they prefer VPC/private for IP/data reasons but said they'd accept Hosted if we can guarantee 30-day retention override + isolated dataset controls. They want SSO before any user invites.

Jordan Kim: So action items: confirm SSO + retention feasibility, final cost estimate that fits $5k if possible, and clear success criteria (latency, correctness evals).

Sam Patel: For perf validation I'll run a small load test plan. Quick load command to run locally (example):
```
# simple wrk example for HTTP completions
wrk -t12 -c200 -d5m --latency 
  -s ./scripts/post-completion.lua 
  --latency --timeout 60000 
  http://redwood-hosted/poc/v1/completions
```
I'll supply the script that posts typical prompts and payload sizes.

Nina Gomez: I'll sketch GPU sizing and a microbench matrix (model variants, quantization, batch sizes). Expected microbench outputs: tokens/sec, p95 latency (ms), and estimated cost per 1k tokens. Will push numbers in ~24 hours.

Maya Rao: Security note: SAML + SCIM can be enabled before POC start but needs a customer IdP metadata file. I can pre-fill our section of the security questionnaire. Also need to confirm we can redact logs for PII — that is supported.

Oliver Chen: FYI on billing structure for POC: we can do a fixed-commit model for 14 days with reconciliation. If they accept a $4.2k committed amount we can cap overage to X% and report daily usage. I'll draft an amendment.

Jordan Kim: Success criteria proposal (draft):
- Functional: >=90% of queries return correct answer as per Acme eval set (we will run their golden prompts).
- Latency: p95 <400ms (single-response).
- Throughput: sustain daytime bursts up to 3.5k tokens/sec without >1% error rate.
- Cost: POC invoice <= $5k (preferred).
- Security: SSO enabled and retention policy set before invites.

Priya Singh: Add one more: Data pipeline — documents ingested and searchable within 24h of dataset handoff.

Sam Patel: Tentative timeline:
- Today: finalize scope & success criteria (this thread).
- +1 day: Nina posts microbench and recommended GPU count + cost scenarios.
- +2 days: we setup SAML + test with Acme IdP.
- +3 days: dry-run load test on Hosted with quantized model.
- Launch POC: next Monday for 14 days.

Jordan Kim: Acme confirmed next Monday works. If we can hit the $5k committed option with hybrid approach we should close.

Nina Gomez: I'll run a quick microbench and include two configs: (A) Hosted + caching (expected cost ~ $3.6k), (B) Dedicated 2xA10G reserved (expected cost ~ $4.2k). Will include exact GPU-hr math.

deploy-bot: Deployment "poc-quantized-canary" started by Sam Patel at 2025-11-18T15:38:12Z.

Oliver Chen: Once Nina posts numbers I'll formalize the POC quote. If numbers exceed $5k we should prepare a short justification for the customer and a fallback (trim duration to 7 days or reduce reserved hours).

Jordan Kim: Great — thanks all. Nina/Sam/Maya/Oliv — please loop me when you have updates. I'll update Acme and ask for IdP metadata.

Sam Patel: noted. I'll also prepare a small eval harness for their golden prompts so we can measure the 90% correctness quickly.

Maya Rao: I'll start the security questionnaire responses. If they need SOC2 evidence, we can provide a read-only artifact link.

Nina Gomez: posting initial microbench snapshot in ~3 hours with numbers.

Jordan Kim: Perfect — closing for now.
